text:
lee: Found a Vault audit payload leak in staging logs. The audit device was configured to log `request.body` for transit/rewrap calls. Not plaintext seen, but wrapped ciphertext + metadata present.

sam: Oof. Example snippet?

lee: `2026-01-12T09:12:01Z INFO vault: path=transit/rewrap ciphertext=v1:... key=projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap`

taylor: That means we are persisting KMS key identifiers and cipher blobs in plain logs. Need containment: 1) disable vault audit device or change filter, 2) rotate IAM binding for service account that called rewrap, 3) snapshot and redact logs.

security-oncall: Agreed. Immediate steps: disable audit device write to stdout in staging and enable filtered audit to secure-bucket. Sam, can you patch the audit filter?

sam: On it. I'll update /etc/vault.d/audit.hcl to redact `request.body` for transit paths and restart. Patch coming in 15m.

audit-bot: Detected 3 matching entries in splunk from the last 48h. Exporting to incident bucket.

lee: Also saw partner SA had write perms to the staging bucket. Recommend revoke until we confirm they aren't sending rewrapped artifacts referencing our keys.

taylor: I'll run TF plan to remove binding and put a conditioned role with prefix constraint on the bucket. Will also add a policy that prevents logging object payloads (org policy).

security-oncall: Make sure to record which key versions exist before rotation. If we rotate/disable a key version, we must coordinate rewrap windows. Consider providing a rewrap endpoint (vault transit) that accepts ciphertext and returns ciphertext without revealing plaintext. Limit to partner SA during rewrap window.

sam: Implemented redaction rule and restarted vault in staging. Rolling patch to prod needs review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/900

lee: I've archived the exported logs to secure bucket and added evidence list to INC-2026-0901.

security-oncall: Good. Taylor, schedule key rotation during low-traffic window and prep a k8s job to run a controlled rewrap of backlog. Ensure SIEM shows no access to unwrapped data after rewrap.

taylor: Scheduling rotation 2026-01-13 03:00 UTC. Will post runbook and create rewrap job.

sam: Also adding metric alert: any vault audit line containing `transit` + `ciphertext=` to high priority channel.

security-oncall: Closing criteria: audit redaction live, partner SA unbound or conditioned, rotation + rewrap complete, backlog verified. Lower severity after.

lee: Thanks all. I'll follow up with partner if we need them to re-encrypt.

security-oncall: Noted. Keep this thread updated.
